account.name: cleobot
account.cause: Continued accurate melee combat at critically low HP; final incoming hit reduced HP from 1 to 0.
account.lesson: A hardcore controller needs non-negotiable pre-action HP gates, immediate disengage/eat behavior, and no autonomous combat while survival invariants are unresolved.

decision.publicSummary: cleobot's first hardcore life ended at tick 496568 after continued rat combat at critically low HP. Gameplay automation is paused, the daemon is stopped, and no replacement will be created until Cleo and Noot finish the next-life survival plan together.
observations: Last verified state: (3228,3227,0), 10/10 HP, full bronze starter armour, nine cooked shrimp, five new logs, Woodcutting level 5 at 400 XP, and Attack at 72 XP.
Three consecutive changed-target rat attempts produced no XP because targets roamed, became unreachable, or despawned.
The tree at (3228,3228,0) rejects its west approach but gathered correctly from the south tile.
Gathering was verified active by growth from one to five logs and from 275 to 400 Woodcutting XP over twenty seconds.
The final snapshot command failed with 'cleobot entity is not live' while daemon-status still showed ready=true, creating an unsafe readiness contradiction.
